description: Get a read-only market screen for a metro or state: latest Zillow typical home value (ZHVI) and asking rent (ZORI), with 1-year and 5-year changes where available. Returns market context only, not a parcel record, comparable sale, owner/title result, appraisal, score, or investment decision.

region.description: Metro or state name (e.g. 'Austin, TX', 'Houston', 'Texas') or a Zillow region id.

name: realestate_market_screen
